nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Authoritative operations manual (schema_version 2.2.0) for the dev_graph engineering digital twin, defining its 24-type ontology, frontmatter governance, 17 relationship types, 11-check lint workflow, and the end-of-session writeback checklist that every dev_graph Claude session must follow.
nodes.languageNotes: Governance contract written as prose with embedded YAML frontmatter templates and Dataview/Cypher snippets; 56 sections spanning vault structure, object hierarchy, and maintenance cadences.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Human-readable orientation for the dev_graph, explaining what the typed implementation graph is, how it relates to the raw/wiki layers, the MCP-driven context-pack architecture, and a quick-start reading order through the governance files.

nodes.name: index.md
nodes.summary: Master index cataloging every dev_graph node grouped by ontology type (architecture, systems, capabilities, modules, files, tests, gates, schemas, decisions, etc.) with a closing statistics section tracking node counts.

nodes.name: log.md
